label: Single market begins
description: The four freedoms — goods, services, capital and people — take effect across the Community

label: Maastricht Treaty in force
description: The European Union is created; the treaty sets the convergence criteria for a single currency

label: Schengen Convention applied
description: Border checks abolished between the first seven participating states

label: EFTA enlargement
description: Austria Finland and Sweden join; Norway's electorate votes no

label: Euro introduced
description: Exchange rates irrevocably fixed for eleven member states; the currency exists in accounting form only

label: Euro notes and coins
description: Physical currency replaces twelve national currencies

label: Enlargement to ten
description: Cyprus Czechia Estonia Hungary Latvia Lithuania Malta Poland Slovakia and Slovenia join in the largest single enlargement

label: Lisbon Treaty in force
description: Extends qualified-majority voting, gives the Charter of Fundamental Rights binding force and creates the European Council presidency

label: First Greek adjustment programme
description: Euro-area states and the IMF agree EUR 110bn in loans; the euro-area sovereign debt crisis begins

label: "Whatever it takes"
description: The ECB president commits to preserving the euro; sovereign spreads begin to fall back

label: United Kingdom referendum
description: 51.9% vote to leave on a turnout of 72.2%

label: United Kingdom leaves
description: First withdrawal of a member state; a transition period runs to 31 December 2020

label: NextGenerationEU agreed
description: The European Council agrees a EUR 750bn recovery instrument funded by joint borrowing — the Union's first large-scale common debt
